review: A process-local ready hint can outlive retirement performed by another process's final keeper. Before returning a cached hint, compare it with the currently published exact endpoint under the caller's already-held shared keeper. Abnormal death remains an actual RPC failure: invalidate without replay; the next independent query resolves/restarts.
